FB-GEM.id: Permata ini masuk ke Kotak Permatamu.
FB-GEM.en: This gem goes into your Gem box.

body.id: Makhluk hidup lahir atau menetas, tumbuh besar, lalu punya keturunan.
body.en: Living things are born or hatch, grow up, then have young of their own.

body.id: Kupu-kupu dan katak berubah bentuk saat tumbuh. Namanya metamorfosis.
body.en: Butterflies and frogs change shape as they grow. That's called metamorphosis.

body.id: Pohon mangga juga: biji, bibit, pohon, bunga, lalu buah berbiji baru.
body.en: A mango tree too: seed, seedling, tree, flower, then fruit with a new seed.

body.id: Separuh piring: sayur dan buah. Separuh lagi: makanan pokok dan lauk pauk.
body.en: Half the plate: vegetables and fruit. The other half: staple food and protein.

body.id: Makanan pokok memberi tenaga, lauk pauk membangun tubuh, sayur dan buah menjaga tubuh sehat.
body.en: Staples give energy, protein builds your body, vegetables and fruit keep you healthy.

body.id: Minum air putih. Minuman manis cukup sesekali saja.
body.en: Drink water. Sweet drinks only now and then.

meaning.en: A butterfly's life cycle.

model_answer.id: Telur → ulat → kepompong → kupu-kupu.
model_answer.en: Egg → caterpillar → pupa → butterfly.

meaning.id: Ulat ini akan menjadi apa sesudahnya?
meaning.en: What does this caterpillar become next?

model_answer.id: Kepompong dulu. Di dalamnya, ulat berubah menjadi kupu-kupu.
model_answer.en: A pupa first. Inside it, the caterpillar turns into a butterfly.

meaning.en: Build the frog's life cycle.

model_answer.id: Telur → berudu → berudu berkaki → katak. Katak tidak punya kepompong.
model_answer.en: Eggs → tadpole → tadpole with legs → frog. Frogs have no pupa.

meaning.en: Where do tadpoles live?

model_answer.id: Di air tawar, seperti kolam atau danau. Berudu bernapas dengan insang.
model_answer.en: In fresh water, like a pond or lake. Tadpoles breathe with gills.

meaning.en: From seed to mango.

model_answer.id: Biji berkecambah → bibit → pohon → bunga → buah. Di dalam buah ada biji baru!
model_answer.en: Sprouting seed → seedling → tree → flower → fruit. Inside the fruit is a new seed!

meaning.en: Hatched or born?

model_answer.id: Menetas: ayam, kura-kura, burung. Lahir: kucing, sapi, kambing.
model_answer.en: Hatch: chicken, turtle, bird. Born: cat, cow, goat.

meaning.id: Induk ayam mengerami telur. Berapa hari sampai menetas?
meaning.en: A hen sits on her eggs. How many days until they hatch?

model_answer.id: Sekitar 21 hari, kira-kira 3 minggu.
model_answer.en: About 21 days, roughly 3 weeks.

meaning.en: Young and grown-up.

model_answer.id: Ulat → kupu-kupu, bibit → pohon, telur → ayam, berudu → katak.
model_answer.en: Caterpillar → butterfly, seedling → tree, egg → chicken, tadpole → frog.

meaning.id: Bunga mangga nanti berubah menjadi apa?
meaning.en: What does a mango flower turn into?

model_answer.id: Menjadi buah. Di dalam buah ada biji untuk pohon baru.
model_answer.en: A fruit. Inside the fruit is a seed for a new tree.

meaning.id: Kupu-kupu, katak, dan ayam berasal dari ____.
meaning.en: Butterflies, frogs and chickens start as ____.

model_answer.id: Telur! Ketiganya menetas dari telur.
model_answer.en: An egg! All three hatch from eggs.

meaning.id: Kupu-kupu kecil tumbuh menjadi kupu-kupu besar.
meaning.en: Small butterflies grow into big butterflies.

model_answer.id: Mitos. Kupu-kupu dewasa tidak tumbuh lagi. Ulatlah yang makan banyak dan tumbuh.
model_answer.en: Myth. Adult butterflies don't grow any more. It's the caterpillar that eats and grows.

model_answer.id: Taruh kapas basah di gelas plastik, lalu letakkan 3 butir kacang hijau di atasnya. Jaga kapasnya tetap lembap. Dalam 1–3 hari, bijinya berkecambah. Gambar perubahannya setiap hari!
model_answer.en: Put wet cotton wool in a plastic cup and lay 3 mung beans on top. Keep the cotton damp. In 1–3 days the seeds sprout. Draw how they change every day!

meaning.en: What comes out of the pupa?

model_answer.id: Kupu-kupu dewasa keluar dari kepompong.
model_answer.en: An adult butterfly comes out of the pupa.

meaning.en: From seed to tree.

model_answer.id: Biji berkecambah → bibit → pohon.
model_answer.en: Sprouting seed → seedling → tree.

meaning.en: Which one hatches from an egg?

model_answer.id: Burung menetas dari telur. Kucing, sapi, dan kambing lahir dari induknya.
model_answer.en: Birds hatch from eggs. Cats, cows and goats are born from their mothers.

items.source: CDC, "Mosquito Bites" and "Life Cycle of Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus Mosquitoes" (cdc.gov/mosquitoes); Kemenkes RI, Gerakan 3M Plus pencegahan DBD (kemkes.go.id).

model_answer.id: Hanya nyamuk betina yang menggigit. Ia butuh darah untuk membuat telur. Telurnya menetas di air menjadi jentik, lalu menjadi nyamuk. Karena itu kita menguras dan menutup tempat air!
model_answer.en: Only female mosquitoes bite. They need blood to make their eggs. The eggs hatch in water into wrigglers, which become mosquitoes. That's why we empty and cover water containers!

meaning.en: Which group?

model_answer.id: Pokok: nasi, roti. Lauk: ikan, telur. Sayur: sayuran. Buah: pepaya, pisang.
model_answer.en: Staples: rice, bread. Protein: fish, egg. Vegetables. Fruit: papaya, banana.

meaning.en: Which plate is balanced?

model_answer.id: Piring seimbang berisi makanan pokok, lauk pauk, sayur, dan buah.
model_answer.en: A balanced plate has a staple, protein, vegetables and fruit.

meaning.en: What does it do for your body?

model_answer.id: Nasi memberi tenaga, ikan membangun tubuh, sayur memberi vitamin, susu menguatkan tulang.
model_answer.en: Rice gives energy, fish builds your body, vegetables give vitamins, milk strengthens bones.

meaning.en: Half the plate is vegetables and ____.

model_answer.id: Buah! Separuh piring sayur dan buah, sayurnya lebih banyak.
model_answer.en: Fruit! Half the plate is vegetables and fruit, with more vegetables.

meaning.id: Label: gula 32 gram. 1 sendok teh = 4 gram. Berapa sendok teh?
meaning.en: Label: 32 g sugar. 1 teaspoon = 4 g. How many teaspoons?

model_answer.id: 32 : 4 = 8 sendok teh gula dalam satu botol!
model_answer.en: 32 ÷ 4 = 8 teaspoons of sugar in one bottle!

meaning.en: Thirsty after playing. What to drink?

model_answer.id: Air putih: menghilangkan haus tanpa gula.
model_answer.en: Water: it quenches thirst with no sugar.

meaning.en: Every day or now and then?

model_answer.id: Setiap hari: sayur, buah, air putih. Sesekali: kue manis, minuman manis.
model_answer.en: Every day: vegetables, fruit, water. Now and then: sweet cake, sweet drinks.

meaning.en: Which one is a protein dish?

model_answer.id: Ayam adalah lauk pauk. Protein membangun otot dan tubuh.
model_answer.en: Chicken is a protein dish. Protein builds muscles and body.

meaning.id: Buah yang manis sama buruknya dengan permen.
meaning.en: Sweet fruit is as bad as sweets.

model_answer.id: Mitos. Buah utuh juga berisi serat, vitamin, dan air. Yang perlu dibatasi adalah gula tambahan.
model_answer.en: Myth. Whole fruit also has fibre, vitamins and water. It's added sugar we should limit.

meaning.id: Di Isi Piringku, mana yang lebih banyak?
meaning.en: On the balanced plate, which is more?

model_answer.id: Sayur lebih banyak daripada buah.
model_answer.en: More vegetables than fruit.

meaning.id: Terlalu banyak gula merusak bagian ini.
meaning.en: Too much sugar harms this part.

model_answer.id: Gigi di mulut. Kuman memakan sisa gula dan membuat gigi berlubang.
model_answer.en: Your teeth. Germs feed on leftover sugar and make holes in teeth.

model_answer.id: Bersama orang dewasa, cari tulisan "Informasi Nilai Gizi" pada kemasan minuman. Temukan angka gula, lalu bagi dengan 4. Itulah jumlah sendok teh gulanya!
model_answer.en: With a grown-up, find the "Nutrition Facts" box on a drink. Find the sugar number and divide it by 4. That's how many teaspoons of sugar it has!

meaning.en: Which staple food gives energy?

model_answer.id: Roti adalah makanan pokok, seperti nasi. Ia memberi tenaga.
model_answer.en: Bread is a staple, like rice. It gives energy.

meaning.en: The other half: staple food and ____.

model_answer.id: Lauk pauk, seperti ikan, ayam, telur, tempe, atau tahu.
model_answer.en: Protein, such as fish, chicken, egg, tempeh or tofu.

meaning.id: Susu cokelat kemasan: gula 20 gram. 1 sendok teh = 4 gram.
meaning.en: Packaged chocolate milk: 20 g sugar. 1 teaspoon = 4 g.

model_answer.id: 20 : 4 = 5 sendok teh gula.
model_answer.en: 20 ÷ 4 = 5 teaspoons of sugar.

meaning.id: Aku menetas di air. Waktu kecil aku berekor dan bernapas dengan insang. Sudah besar, aku melompat di darat. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I hatch in water. When I'm young I have a tail and breathe with gills. When I grow up I hop on land. Who am I?

model_answer.id: Katak! Waktu kecil namanya berudu.
model_answer.en: A frog! When it's young it's called a tadpole.
